learning_outcomes.text: Compose clear, professional email with correct recipients
Organise mail with labels, filters and search operators
Manage workflow with stars, snooze and priority inbox
Use templates, signatures and scheduled send
Collaborate using delegation, groups and shared mailboxes
Apply security and etiquette practices for safe email

integrative_case: Bring an overloaded inbox under control: build labels and filters to auto-sort mail, use search operators to triage, create reply templates and scheduled send, delegate during leave, and apply phishing checks and confidential mode for a sensitive thread.
